title: Child actions and MVC 5 only Razor features
description: Views that use ASP.NET MVC 5 features that do not exist in ASP.NET Core: child actions, @helper blocks, App_Code helpers, and request statics in views.

impact.summary: Child actions are no longer supported in ASP.NET Core MVC; view components replace them.

sources.evidence: we used Child Actions to build reusable components/widgets consisting of both Razor markup and backend logic
Child Actions are no longer supported in ASP.NET Core MVC. Instead, we will use the View Component feature.

handling.option: Rebuild child actions as view components
handling.when: A child action renders a reusable widget with its own logic

sources.evidence: we used Child Actions to build reusable components/widgets consisting of both Razor markup and backend logic
View components are similar to partial views, but they're much more powerful

handling.option: Rebuild @helper blocks and simple child actions as partial views, tag helpers, or Razor local functions
handling.when: The helper has no logic of its own

checks.text: Every page that used a child action or helper renders the same markup (compare before and after on the local site)
